decisions.reason: Retaining the author-name-first arrangement on the interior title page does not change the copyright page's content or alignment.
The decision concerns ordering on the title page and does not alter the general interior trim size, spacing, or page-density rules.
The title-page arrangement does not change chapter-title, subtitle, or heading formatting.
The source decision does not change chapter illustration selection, placement, size, or rendering quality.
Retaining the title page's current author and title ordering does not affect the separate prohibition on a literal newline artifact in the book title.
The decision to retain the title-page arrangement neither cancels nor changes the page-numbering and table-of-contents requirements.
The title-page ordering decision has no effect on dedication content or its requested deletions.
The decision does not change the italic styling required for Mama's Hot Take callouts.
The interior title-page layout choice does not alter manuscript wording, punctuation, or copyediting rules.
The source resolves the interior title page only and does not establish any change to the separate paperback cover design.
Retaining the author's name position on the interior title page does not change the required back matter or author copy.
The title-page layout decision does not affect KDP keyword content, its delivery format, or its intended use.
